    38	/** Check that claimed dependencies exist in manifests */
    39	export function checkDependencies(
    40	  claims: Claim[],
    41	  projectRoot: string
    42	): DriftIssue[] {
    43	  const issues: DriftIssue[] = [];
    44	  const deps = loadAllDependencies(projectRoot);
    45	  if (!deps) return issues;
    46	
    47	  const depClaims = claims.filter(
    48	    (c) => c.kind === "dependency" && !c.negated
    49	  );
    50	  const versionClaims = claims.filter(
    51	    (c) => c.kind === "version" && !c.negated
    52	  );
    53	
    54	  for (const claim of depClaims) {
    55	    const name = claim.value.toLowerCase();
    56	
    57	    // Skip known runtimes/platforms — they won't be in package.json
    58	    if (KNOWN_RUNTIMES.has(name)) continue;
    59	
    60	    // Fuzzy match: "React" → "react", "Express" → "express"
    61	    const found = deps.find(
    62	      (d) => d.name.toLowerCase() === name
    63	    );
    64	    if (!found) {
    65	      issues.push({
    66	        code: "DEPENDENCY_MISSING",
    67	        severity: "warning",
    68	        file: claim.source,
    69	        line: claim.line,
    70	        message: `Claimed dependency "${claim.value}" not found in any manifest`,
    71	        claim,
    72	      });
    73	    }
    74	  }
    75	
    76	  for (const claim of versionClaims) {
    77	    // Parse "React 18" or "Node v20"
    78	    const match = claim.value.match(/^(.+?)\s+v?(\d[\d.]*\S*)$/);
    79	    if (!match) continue;
    80	
    81	    const name = match[1].trim().toLowerCase();
    82	    const claimedVersion = match[2];
    83	    const found = deps.find(
    84	      (d) => d.name.toLowerCase() === name
    85	    );
    86	
    87	    if (found && !found.version.includes(claimedVersion)) {
    88	      issues.push({
    89	        code: "VERSION_MISMATCH",
    90	        severity: "warning",
    91	        file: claim.source,
    92	        line: claim.line,
    93	        message: `Claimed "${claim.value}" but manifest has version "${found.version}"`,
    94	        claim,
    95	      });
    96	    }
    97	  }
    98	
    99	  return issues;
   100	}
   101	
   102	interface DepEntry {
   103	  name: string;
   104	  version: string;
   105	}
   106	
   107	function loadAllDependencies(projectRoot: string): DepEntry[] | null {
   108	  const entries: DepEntry[] = [];
   109	
   110	  // package.json
   111	  const pkgPath = resolve(projectRoot, "package.json");
   112	  if (existsSync(pkgPath)) {
   113	    try {
   114	      const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgPath, "utf-8"));
   115	      for (const [name, version] of Object.entries(pkg.dependencies ?? {})) {
   116	        entries.push({ name, version: String(version) });
   117	      }
   118	      for (const [name, version] of Object.entries(pkg.devDependencies ?? {})) {
   119	        entries.push({ name, version: String(version) });
   120	      }
   121	    } catch {
   122	      // skip
   123	    }
   124	  }
   125	
   126	  return entries.length ? entries : null;
   127	}

     1	import type { Claim, DriftIssue } from "../../types.js";
     2	
     3	/** Detect contradictions across scaffold files */
     4	export function checkCrossFile(claims: Claim[]): DriftIssue[] {
     5	  const issues: DriftIssue[] = [];
     6	
     7	  // Group version claims by dependency name
     8	  const versionsByDep = new Map<string, Claim[]>();
     9	  for (const claim of claims.filter((c) => c.kind === "version" && !c.negated)) {
    10	    const match = claim.value.match(/^(.+?)\s+v?(\d[\d.]*\S*)$/);
    11	    if (!match) continue;
    12	    const depName = match[1].trim().toLowerCase();
    13	    if (!versionsByDep.has(depName)) versionsByDep.set(depName, []);
    14	    versionsByDep.get(depName)!.push(claim);
    15	  }
    16	
    17	  // Check for conflicting versions across different files
    18	  for (const [dep, versionClaims] of versionsByDep) {
    19	    if (versionClaims.length < 2) continue;
    20	
    21	    const uniqueVersions = new Set(versionClaims.map((c) => c.value));
    22	    if (uniqueVersions.size > 1) {
    23	      const sources = versionClaims
    24	        .map((c) => `${c.source}:${c.line} says "${c.value}"`)
    25	        .join(", ");
    26	      issues.push({
    27	        code: "CROSS_FILE_CONFLICT",
    28	        severity: "error",
    29	        file: versionClaims[0].source,
    30	        line: versionClaims[0].line,
    31	        message: `Conflicting versions for "${dep}": ${sources}`,
    32	      });
    33	    }
    34	  }
    35	
    36	  // Group command claims that reference the same script
    37	  const commandsByScript = new Map<string, Claim[]>();
    38	  for (const claim of claims.filter((c) => c.kind === "command" && !c.negated)) {
    39	    const npmMatch = claim.value.match(
    40	      /^(?:npm\s+run|yarn|pnpm|bun\s+run)\s+(\S+)/
    41	    );
    42	    if (npmMatch) {
    43	      const script = npmMatch[1];
    44	      if (!commandsByScript.has(script)) commandsByScript.set(script, []);
    45	      commandsByScript.get(script)!.push(claim);
    46	    }
    47	  }
    48	
    49	  // Check for same script referenced with different package managers
    50	  for (const [script, cmdClaims] of commandsByScript) {
    51	    if (cmdClaims.length < 2) continue;
    52	    const fromDifferentFiles = new Set(cmdClaims.map((c) => c.source)).size > 1;
    53	    if (!fromDifferentFiles) continue;
    54	
    55	    const managers = new Set(
    56	      cmdClaims.map((c) => c.value.split(/\s/)[0])
    57	    );
    58	    if (managers.size > 1) {
    59	      issues.push({
    60	        code: "CROSS_FILE_CONFLICT",
    61	        severity: "warning",
    62	        file: cmdClaims[0].source,
    63	        line: cmdClaims[0].line,
    64	        message: `Script "${script}" referenced with different package managers across files: ${[...managers].join(", ")}`,
    65	      });
    66	    }
    67	  }
    68	
    69	  return issues;
    70	}

     5	/** npm lifecycle hooks and internal scripts that don't need documentation */
     6	const IGNORED_SCRIPTS = new Set([
     7	  "preinstall",
     8	  "install",
     9	  "postinstall",
    10	  "preuninstall",
    11	  "uninstall",
    12	  "postuninstall",
    13	  "prepublish",
    14	  "prepublishOnly",
    15	  "publish",
    16	  "postpublish",
    17	  "prepack",
    18	  "pack",
    19	  "postpack",
    20	  "prepare",
    21	  "preshrinkwrap",
    22	  "shrinkwrap",
    23	  "postshrinkwrap",
    24	]);
    25	
    26	/** Check that package.json scripts are mentioned somewhere in the scaffold */
    27	export function checkScriptCoverage(
    28	  scaffoldFiles: string[],
    29	  projectRoot: string
    30	): DriftIssue[] {
    31	  const scripts = loadPackageScripts(projectRoot);
    32	  if (!scripts) return [];
    33	
    34	  // Collect all scaffold text to search against
    35	  const scaffoldText = scaffoldFiles
    36	    .map((f) => {
    37	      try {
    38	        return readFileSync(f, "utf-8");
    39	      } catch {
    40	        return "";
    41	      }
    42	    })
    43	    .join("\n");
    44	
    45	  const issues: DriftIssue[] = [];
    46	
    47	  for (const script of scripts) {
    48	    // Skip lifecycle hooks
    49	    if (IGNORED_SCRIPTS.has(script)) continue;
    50	
    51	    // Skip pre/post variants of other scripts (e.g. pretest, postbuild)
    52	    if (
    53	      (script.startsWith("pre") && scripts.has(script.slice(3))) ||
    54	      (script.startsWith("post") && scripts.has(script.slice(4)))
    55	    ) {
    56	      continue;
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    // Skip colon variants if the base script is documented (e.g. dev:debug when dev exists)
    60	    if (script.includes(":")) {
    61	      const base = script.split(":")[0];
    62	      if (scaffoldText.includes(base)) continue;
    63	    }
    64	
    65	    // Check if the script name appears anywhere in scaffold files
    66	    if (!scaffoldText.includes(script)) {
    67	      issues.push({
    68	        code: "UNDOCUMENTED_SCRIPT",
    69	        severity: "warning",
    70	        file: "package.json",
    71	        line: null,
    72	        message: `Script "${script}" exists in package.json but is not mentioned in any scaffold file`,
    73	      });
    74	    }
    75	  }
    76	
    77	  return issues;
    78	}
    79	
    80	function loadPackageScripts(projectRoot: string): Set<string> | null {
    81	  const pkgPath = resolve(projectRoot, "package.json");
    82	  if (!existsSync(pkgPath)) return null;
    83	  try {
    84	    const pkg = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pkgPath, "utf-8"));
    85	    const scripts = pkg.scripts ?? {};
    86	    return Object.keys(scripts).length ? new Set(Object.keys(scripts)) : null;
    87	  } catch {
    88	    return null;
    89	  }
    90	}

     6	export async function runPatternAdd(config: MexConfig, name: string) {
     7	  if (!/^[a-z0-9-]+$/i.test(name)) {
     8	    throw new Error(`Invalid pattern name '${name}'. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens.`);
     9	  }
    10	
    11	  const patternsDir = join(config.scaffoldRoot, "patterns");
    12	  const patternPath = join(patternsDir, `${name}.md`);
    13	  const indexPath = join(patternsDir, "INDEX.md");
    14	
    15	  if (existsSync(patternPath)) {
    16	    throw new Error(`Pattern '${name}' already exists at ${patternPath}`);
    17	  }
    18	
    19	  const today = new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0];
    20	
    21	  const template = `---
    22	name: ${name}
    23	description: [one line — what this pattern covers and when to use it]
    24	triggers:
    25	  - "[keyword that should trigger loading this file]"
    26	edges:
    27	  - target: "context/conventions.md"
    28	    condition: "when verifying this task"
    29	last_updated: ${today}
    30	---
    31	
    32	# ${name}
    33	
    34	## Context
    35	[What to load or know before starting this task type]
    36	
    37	## Steps
    38	[The workflow — what to do, in what order]
    39	
    40	## Gotchas
    41	[The things that go wrong. What to watch out for.]
    42	
    43	## Verify
    44	[Checklist to run after completing this task type]
    45	
    46	## Debug
    47	[What to check when this task type breaks]
    48	
    49	## Update Scaffold
    50	- [ ] Update \`ROUTER.md\` "Current Project State" if what's working/not built has changed
    51	- [ ] Update any \`context/\` files that are now out of date
    52	- [ ] If this is a new task type without a pattern, create one in \`patterns/\` and add to \`INDEX.md\`
    53	`;
    54	
    55	  mkdirSync(patternsDir, { recursive: true });
    56	  writeFileSync(patternPath, template, "utf8");
    57	
    58	  if (existsSync(indexPath)) {
    59	    const currentIndex = readFileSync(indexPath, "utf8");
    60	    const newlinePrefix = currentIndex.length === 0 || currentIndex.endsWith("\n") ? "" : "\n";
    61	    const entry = `${newlinePrefix}| [${name}.md](${name}.md) | [description] |\n`;
    62	    appendFileSync(indexPath, entry, "utf8");
    63	  }
    64	
    65	  console.log(chalk.green(`✓ Created pattern ${name}.md`));
    66	  console.log(chalk.dim(`  Added entry to patterns/INDEX.md`));
    67	  console.log(chalk.yellow(`! Remember to edit patterns/INDEX.md and replace [description] with a real use case.`));
    68	}

    29	/** Run targeted sync: detect → brief → AI → verify → ask → loop */
    30	export async function runSync(
    31	  config: MexConfig,
    32	  opts: { dryRun?: boolean; includeWarnings?: boolean }
    33	): Promise<void> {
    34	  let cycle = 0;
    35	  let mode: SyncMode | null = null;
    36	
    37	  while (true) {
    38	    cycle++;
    39	
    40	    // Step 1: Run drift check
    41	    if (cycle === 1) {
    42	      console.log(chalk.bold("Running drift check..."));
    43	    } else {
    44	      console.log(chalk.bold("\nRe-checking for remaining drift..."));
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    const report = await runDriftCheck(config);
    48	
    49	    if (report.issues.length === 0) {
    50	      console.log(chalk.green("✓ No drift detected. Everything is in sync."));
    51	      return;
    52	    }
    53	
    54	    console.log(
    55	      chalk.yellow(
    56	        `Found ${report.issues.length} issues (score: ${report.score}/100)`
    57	      )
    58	    );
    59	
    60	    // Step 2: Group issues by file
    61	    const relevantIssues = opts.includeWarnings
    62	      ? report.issues
    63	      : report.issues.filter((i) => {
    64	          const fileHasError = report.issues.some(
    65	            (other) => other.file === i.file && other.severity === "error"
    66	          );
    67	          return fileHasError;
    68	        });
    69	
    70	    if (relevantIssues.length === 0) {
    71	      console.log(
    72	        chalk.green(
    73	          "No errors found. Only warnings remain (use --warnings to include them)."
    74	        )
    75	      );
    76	      return;
    77	    }
    78	
    79	    const targets = groupIntoTargets(relevantIssues);
    80	
    81	    console.log(
    82	      chalk.bold(`\n${targets.length} file(s) need attention:\n`)
    83	    );
    84	
    85	    for (const target of targets) {
    86	      const errors = target.issues.filter(
    87	        (i) => i.severity === "error"
    88	      ).length;
    89	      const warnings = target.issues.filter(
    90	        (i) => i.severity === "warning"
    91	      ).length;
    92	      console.log(
    93	        `  ${target.file} — ${errors} errors, ${warnings} warnings`
    94	      );
    95	    }
    96	
    97	    // Dry run — show combined prompt and exit
    98	    if (opts.dryRun) {
    99	      console.log(
   100	        chalk.dim("\n--dry-run: showing prompt without executing\n")
   101	      );
   102	      const brief = await buildCombinedBrief(targets, config.projectRoot);

   115	      console.log();

   119	
   120	      switch (picked) {
   121	        case "1":
   122	          mode = "interactive";
   123	          break;
   124	        case "2":
   125	          mode = "prompts";
   126	          break;
   127	        case "3":
   128	          console.log(chalk.dim("Exiting. Run mex sync again anytime."));
   129	          return;
   130	        default:
   131	          console.log(chalk.dim("Exiting."));
   132	          return;
   133	      }
   134	    }

   178	
   179	    if (remainingErrors === 0 && !opts.includeWarnings) {
   180	      if (remainingWarnings > 0) {

   207	      console.log(chalk.dim("Stopped. Run mex sync again anytime."));
   208	      return;
   209	    }
   210	  }
   211	}

   213	function groupIntoTargets(issues: DriftIssue[]): SyncTarget[] {
   214	  const byFile = new Map<string, DriftIssue[]>();
   215	  for (const issue of issues) {
   216	    if (!byFile.has(issue.file)) byFile.set(issue.file, []);
   217	    byFile.get(issue.file)!.push(issue);
   218	  }
   219	
   220	  return Array.from(byFile.entries()).map(([file, issues]) => ({
   221	    file,
   222	    issues,
   223	    gitDiff: null,
   224	  }));
   225	}

    41	/** Build the content section for a single target (no wrapper instructions) */
    42	async function buildFileSection(
    43	  target: SyncTarget,
    44	  projectRoot: string
    45	): Promise<string> {
    46	  const filePath = resolve(projectRoot, target.file);
    47	  let fileContent: string;
    48	  try {
    49	    fileContent = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
    50	  } catch {
    51	    fileContent = "(file could not be read)";
    52	  }
    53	
    54	  const issueList = target.issues
    55	    .map((i) => `- [${i.severity}] ${i.code}: ${i.message}`)
    56	    .join("\n");
    57	
    58	  // Get git diff for paths referenced by this file's claims
    59	  const claimedPaths = target.issues
    60	    .filter((i) => i.claim?.kind === "path")
    61	    .map((i) => i.claim!.value);
    62	
    63	  const diff = claimedPaths.length
    64	    ? await getGitDiff(claimedPaths, projectRoot)
    65	    : target.gitDiff ?? "";
    66	
    67	  // For MISSING_PATH issues, find what actually exists nearby
    68	  const fileContext = buildFileContext(target, projectRoot);
    69	
    70	  let section = `**File:** ${target.file}
    71	
    72	**Issues found:**
    73	${issueList}
    74	
    75	**Current file content:**
    76	\`\`\`markdown
    77	${fileContent}
    78	\`\`\``;
    79	
    80	  if (fileContext) {
    81	    section += `
    82	
    83	**Filesystem context (what actually exists):**
    84	${fileContext}`;
    85	  }
    86	
    87	  if (diff) {
    88	    section += `
    89	
    90	**Recent git changes in referenced paths:**
    91	\`\`\`diff
    92	${diff}
    93	\`\`\``;
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  return section;
    97	}
    98	
    99	/** For missing path issues, list actual files in the relevant directories */
   100	function buildFileContext(
   101	  target: SyncTarget,
   102	  projectRoot: string
   103	): string | null {
   104	  const missingPaths = target.issues
   105	    .filter((i) => i.code === "MISSING_PATH" && i.claim?.kind === "path")
   106	    .map((i) => i.claim!.value);
   107	
   108	  if (missingPaths.length === 0) return null;
   109	
   110	  const sections: string[] = [];
   111	  const listedDirs = new Set<string>();
   112	
   113	  for (const missing of missingPaths) {
   114	    // Get the directory the missing file was expected in
   115	    const dir = missing.includes("/") ? dirname(missing) : ".";
   116	    const dirKey = dir === "." ? "root" : dir;
   117	
   118	    // List the directory contents (skip if already listed)
   119	    if (!listedDirs.has(dirKey)) {
   120	      listedDirs.add(dirKey);
   121	
   122	      const absDir = resolve(projectRoot, dir);
   123	      if (existsSync(absDir)) {
   124	        try {
   125	          const files = readdirSync(absDir)
   126	            .filter((f) => !f.startsWith("."))
   127	            .sort();
   128	          if (files.length > 0) {
   129	            sections.push(`\`${dir}/\` contains: ${files.join(", ")}`);
   130	          }
   131	        } catch {
   132	          // skip unreadable dirs
   133	        }
   134	      }
   135	    }
   136	
   137	    // Fuzzy search: find files with similar names anywhere in the project
   138	    const name = basename(missing);
   139	    const ext = name.includes(".") ? name.split(".").pop() : null;
   140	    if (ext) {
   141	      const matches = globSync(`**/*.${ext}`, {
   142	        cwd: projectRoot,
   143	        ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".mex/**", "dist/**", ".git/**"],
   144	        maxDepth: 5,
   145	      });
   146	
   147	      if (matches.length > 0 && matches.length <= 20) {
   148	        sections.push(
   149	          `All \`.${ext}\` files in project: ${matches.join(", ")}`
   150	        );
   151	        // Only list once per extension
   152	        break;
   153	      }
   154	    }
   155	  }
   156	
   157	  return sections.length > 0 ? sections.join("\n") : null;
   158	}

    17	/** Run full drift detection across all scaffold files */
    18	export async function runDriftCheck(config: MexConfig): Promise<DriftReport> {
    19	  const { projectRoot, scaffoldRoot } = config;
    20	
    21	  // Find all markdown files in scaffold
    22	  const scaffoldFiles = findScaffoldFiles(projectRoot, scaffoldRoot);
    23	  const allClaims: Claim[] = [];
    24	  const allIssues: DriftIssue[] = [];
    25	
    26	  // Extract claims from all files
    27	  for (const filePath of scaffoldFiles) {
    28	    const source = relative(projectRoot, filePath);
    29	    const claims = extractClaims(filePath, source);
    30	    allClaims.push(...claims);
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  // Run checkers that work on individual files
    34	  for (const filePath of scaffoldFiles) {
    35	    const source = relative(projectRoot, filePath);
    36	
    37	    // Frontmatter edge check
    38	    const frontmatter = parseFrontmatter(filePath);
    39	    allIssues.push(
    40	      ...checkEdges(frontmatter, filePath, source, projectRoot, scaffoldRoot)
    41	    );
    42	
    43	    // Staleness check
    44	    const stalenessIssues = await checkStaleness(source, source, projectRoot);
    45	    allIssues.push(...stalenessIssues);
    46	  }
    47	
    48	  // Run checkers that work on claims
    49	  allIssues.push(...checkPaths(allClaims, projectRoot, scaffoldRoot));
    50	  allIssues.push(...checkCommands(allClaims, projectRoot));
    51	  allIssues.push(...checkDependencies(allClaims, projectRoot));
    52	  allIssues.push(...checkCrossFile(allClaims));
    53	
    54	  // Run structural checkers
    55	  allIssues.push(...checkIndexSync(projectRoot, scaffoldRoot));
    56	
    57	  // Run coverage checkers (reality → scaffold direction)
    58	  allIssues.push(...checkScriptCoverage(scaffoldFiles, projectRoot));
    59	
    60	  const score = computeScore(allIssues);
    61	
    62	  return {
    63	    score,
    64	    issues: allIssues,
    65	    filesChecked: scaffoldFiles.length,
    66	    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    67	  };
    68	}
    69	
    70	/** Find all markdown files that are part of the scaffold */
    71	function findScaffoldFiles(
    72	  projectRoot: string,
    73	  scaffoldRoot: string
    74	): string[] {
    75	  const scaffoldPatterns = [
    76	    "context/*.md",
    77	    "patterns/*.md",
    78	    "ROUTER.md",
    79	    "AGENTS.md",
    80	    "SETUP.md",
    81	    "SYNC.md",
    82	  ];
    83	
    84	  const files: string[] = [];
    85	
    86	  // Search inside scaffold root (handles both .mex/ and root layouts)
    87	  for (const pattern of scaffoldPatterns) {
    88	    const matches = globSync(pattern, {
    89	      cwd: scaffoldRoot,
    90	      absolute: true,
    91	      ignore: ["node_modules/**"],
    92	    });
    93	    files.push(...matches);
    94	  }
    95	
    96	  // Also check project root for tool config files (CLAUDE.md, etc.)
    97	  if (scaffoldRoot !== projectRoot) {
    98	    for (const name of ["CLAUDE.md", ".cursorrules", ".windsurfrules"]) {
    99	      const matches = globSync(name, {
   100	        cwd: projectRoot,
   101	        absolute: true,
   102	        ignore: ["node_modules/**"],
   103	      });
   104	      files.push(...matches);
   105	    }
   106	  }
   107	
   108	  // Deduplicate
   109	  return [...new Set(files)];
   110	}

     1	import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";

     4	import type { Claim } from "../types.js";
     5	import type { Root, Code, InlineCode, Strong, Text } from "mdast";
     6	
     7	const KNOWN_EXTENSIONS = /\.(ts|js|tsx|jsx|py|go|rs|rb|java|json|yaml|yml|toml|md|css|scss|html|vue|svelte|sh)$/;
     8	const COMMAND_PREFIXES = /^(npm|yarn|pnpm|bun|make|cargo|python|pip|go|node|npx|tsx)\s/;
     9	const DEPENDENCY_SECTION_PATTERNS = /key\s*libraries|core\s*technologies|dependencies|stack|tech/i;
    10	/** Paths with angle brackets or square brackets are template placeholders, not real paths */
    11	const TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER = /[<>\[\]{}]/;
    12	
    13	/** HTTP methods that indicate an API route, not a file path */
    14	const HTTP_METHOD_PREFIX = /^(GET|POST|PUT|PATCH|DELETE|HEAD|OPTIONS)\s+\//;
    15	
    16	/** Things that look like paths but are actually code snippets, URL routes, or other non-path content */
    17	function isNotAPath(value: string): boolean {
    18	  // URL routes: /voice/incoming, /api/users — start with / but have no file extension
    19	  if (value.startsWith("/") && !KNOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(value)) return true;
    20	
    21	  // HTTP method + route: GET /api/bookmarks, POST /users/:id
    22	  if (HTTP_METHOD_PREFIX.test(value)) return true;
    23	
    24	  // Code snippets: contains =, (), ;, or other code-like characters
    25	  if (/[=();,]/.test(value)) return true;
    26	
    27	  // Quoted strings or attribute assignments: gather.action="...", foo="bar"
    28	  if (/["']/.test(value)) return true;
    29	
    30	  // Wildcard prefixes like *_streaming_client.py — patterns, not real paths
    31	  if (value.startsWith("*")) return true;
    32	
    33	  return false;
    34	}
    35	
    36	/** Extract all claims from a markdown file */
    37	export function extractClaims(filePath: string, source: string): Claim[] {
    38	  let content: string;
    39	  try {
    40	    content = readFileSync(filePath, "utf-8");
    41	  } catch {
    42	    return [];
    43	  }
    44	
    45	  const tree = parseMarkdown(content);
    46	  const claims: Claim[] = [];
    47	
    48	  // Extract from inline code
    49	  visit(tree, "inlineCode", (node: InlineCode) => {
    50	    const line = node.position?.start.line ?? 0;
    51	    const heading = getHeadingAtLine(tree, line);
    52	    const negated = isNegatedSection(heading);
    53	
    54	    // Path claims: contains / or ends in known extension
    55	    if (node.value.includes("/") || KNOWN_EXTENSIONS.test(node.value)) {
    56	      // Skip commands, template placeholders, and non-path content
    57	      if (!COMMAND_PREFIXES.test(node.value) && !TEMPLATE_PLACEHOLDER.test(node.value) && !isNotAPath(node.value)) {
    58	        claims.push({
    59	          kind: "path",
    60	          value: node.value,
    61	          source,
    62	          line,
    63	          section: heading,
    64	          negated,
    65	        });
    66	      }
    67	    }
    68	
    69	    // Command claims
    70	    if (COMMAND_PREFIXES.test(node.value)) {
    71	      claims.push({
    72	        kind: "command",
    73	        value: node.value,
    74	        source,
    75	        line,
    76	        section: heading,
    77	        negated,
    78	      });
    79	    }
    80	  });
    81	
    82	  // Extract from code blocks
    83	  visit(tree, "code", (node: Code) => {
    84	    const line = node.position?.start.line ?? 0;
    85	    const heading = getHeadingAtLine(tree, line);
    86	    const negated = isNegatedSection(heading);
    87	
    88	    // Each line of the code block could be a command
    89	    for (const codeLine of node.value.split("\n")) {
    90	      const trimmed = codeLine.trim();
    91	      if (COMMAND_PREFIXES.test(trimmed)) {
    92	        claims.push({
    93	          kind: "command",
    94	          value: trimmed,
    95	          source,
    96	          line,
    97	          section: heading,
    98	          negated,
    99	        });
   100	      }
   101	    }
   102	  });
   103	
   104	  // Extract dependencies from **BoldName** patterns in relevant sections
   105	  visit(tree, "strong", (node: Strong) => {
   106	    const line = node.position?.start.line ?? 0;
   107	    const heading = getHeadingAtLine(tree, line);
   108	    const negated = isNegatedSection(heading);
   109	
   110	    if (heading && DEPENDENCY_SECTION_PATTERNS.test(heading)) {
   111	      const text = getStrongText(node);
   112	      if (!text) return;
   113	
   114	      // Check for version pattern: "React 18" or "Node v20"
   115	      const versionMatch = text.match(/^(.+?)\s+[v^~>=<]*(\d[\d.]*\S*)$/);
   116	      if (versionMatch) {
   117	        claims.push({
   118	          kind: "dependency",
   119	          value: versionMatch[1].trim(),
   120	          source,
   121	          line,
   122	          section: heading,
   123	          negated,
   124	        });
   125	        claims.push({
   126	          kind: "version",
   127	          value: text,
   128	          source,
   129	          line,
   130	          section: heading,
   131	          negated,
   132	        });
   133	      } else {
   134	        claims.push({
   135	          kind: "dependency",
   136	          value: text,
   137	          source,
   138	          line,
   139	          section: heading,
   140	          negated,
   141	        });
   142	      }
   143	    }
   144	  });
   145	
   146	  return claims;
   147	}
   148	
   149	function getStrongText(node: Strong): string | null {
   150	  const textNode = node.children.find(
   151	    (c): c is Text => c.type === "text"
   152	  );
   153	  return textNode?.value ?? null;
   154	}

     1	import { unified } from "unified";
     2	import remarkParse from "remark-parse";
     3	import remarkFrontmatter from "remark-frontmatter";
     4	import { visit } from "unist-util-visit";
     5	import YAML from "yaml";
     6	import type { ScaffoldFrontmatter } from "./types.js";
     7	import type { Root, Content } from "mdast";
     8	
     9	const parser = unified().use(remarkParse).use(remarkFrontmatter, ["yaml"]);
    10	
    11	/** Parse markdown string into AST */
    12	export function parseMarkdown(content: string): Root {
    13	  return parser.parse(content);
    14	}
    15	
    16	/** Extract YAML frontmatter from markdown content */
    17	export function extractFrontmatter(
    18	  content: string
    19	): ScaffoldFrontmatter | null {
    20	  const tree = parseMarkdown(content);
    21	  let frontmatter: ScaffoldFrontmatter | null = null;
    22	
    23	  visit(tree, "yaml", (node: { value: string }) => {
    24	    try {
    25	      frontmatter = YAML.parse(node.value) as ScaffoldFrontmatter;
    26	    } catch {
    27	      // Invalid YAML — skip
    28	    }
    29	  });
    30	
    31	  return frontmatter;
    32	}
    33	
    34	/** Get the current heading context for a given line position */
    35	export function getHeadingAtLine(
    36	  tree: Root,
    37	  line: number
    38	): string | null {
    39	  let currentHeading: string | null = null;
    40	
    41	  for (const node of tree.children) {
    42	    if (!node.position) continue;
    43	    if (node.position.start.line > line) break;
    44	    if (node.type === "heading") {
    45	      currentHeading = getTextContent(node);
    46	    }
    47	  }
    48	
    49	  return currentHeading;
    50	}
    51	
    52	/** Extract plain text from an AST node */
    53	export function getTextContent(node: Content | Root): string {
    54	  if ("value" in node && typeof node.value === "string") {
    55	    return node.value;
    56	  }
    57	  if ("children" in node) {
    58	    return (node.children as Content[]).map(getTextContent).join("");
    59	  }
    60	  return "";
    61	}
    62	
    63	/** Check if a heading or its ancestors suggest negation */
    64	export function isNegatedSection(heading: string | null): boolean {
    65	  if (!heading) return false;
    66	  const lower = heading.toLowerCase();
    67	  return (
    68	    lower.includes("not exist") ||
    69	    lower.includes("not use") ||
    70	    lower.includes("deliberately not") ||
    71	    lower.includes("excluded") ||
    72	    lower.includes("removed") ||
    73	    lower.includes("deprecated")
    74	  );
    75	}

     3	import chalk from "chalk";
     4	import type { MexConfig } from "./types.js";
     5	
     6	const HOOK_MARKER = "# mex-drift-check";
     7	
     8	function buildHookContent(config: MexConfig): string {
     9	  const cliPath = resolve(config.scaffoldRoot, "dist", "cli.js");
    10	  // Use local CLI if built, otherwise fall back to npx
    11	  const cmd = existsSync(cliPath)
    12	    ? `node "${cliPath}" check --quiet`
    13	    : "npx mex check --quiet";
    14	
    15	  return `#!/bin/sh
    16	${HOOK_MARKER}
    17	# Auto-installed by mex watch — runs drift check after each commit
    18	SCORE=$(${cmd} 2>&1) || true
    19	# Only show output if there are issues (not a perfect score)
    20	case "$SCORE" in
    21	  *"100/100"*) ;;
    22	  *) echo "$SCORE" ;;
    23	esac
    24	`;
    25	}
    26	
    27	export async function manageHook(
    28	  config: MexConfig,
    29	  opts: { uninstall?: boolean }
    30	): Promise<void> {
    31	  const hookPath = resolve(config.projectRoot, ".git", "hooks", "post-commit");
    32	
    33	  if (opts.uninstall) {
    34	    uninstallHook(hookPath);
    35	    return;
    36	  }
    37	
    38	  installHook(hookPath, config);
    39	}
    40	
    41	function installHook(hookPath: string, config: MexConfig): void {
    42	  const hookContent = buildHookContent(config);
    43	
    44	  if (existsSync(hookPath)) {
    45	    const existing = readFileSync(hookPath, "utf-8");
    46	    if (existing.includes(HOOK_MARKER)) {
    47	      console.log(chalk.yellow("mex post-commit hook is already installed."));
    48	      return;
    49	    }
    50	
    51	    // Append to existing hook
    52	    const updated = existing.trimEnd() + "\n\n" + hookContent;
    53	    writeFileSync(hookPath, updated);
    54	    chmodSync(hookPath, 0o755);
    55	    console.log(
    56	      chalk.green("Added mex drift check to existing post-commit hook.")
    57	    );
    58	    return;
    59	  }
    60	
    61	  writeFileSync(hookPath, hookContent);
    62	  chmodSync(hookPath, 0o755);
    63	  console.log(chalk.green("Installed mex post-commit hook."));
    64	}
    65	
    66	function uninstallHook(hookPath: string): void {
    67	  if (!existsSync(hookPath)) {
    68	    console.log(chalk.yellow("No post-commit hook found."));
    69	    return;
    70	  }
    71	
    72	  const content = readFileSync(hookPath, "utf-8");
    73	  if (!content.includes(HOOK_MARKER)) {
    74	    console.log(
    75	      chalk.yellow("post-commit hook exists but was not installed by mex.")
    76	    );
    77	    return;
    78	  }
    79	
    80	  // Remove mex section (everything between marker and next non-mex line)
    81	  const lines = content.split("\n");
    82	  const filtered: string[] = [];
    83	  let inMexBlock = false;
    84	
    85	  for (const line of lines) {
    86	    if (line.includes(HOOK_MARKER)) {
    87	      inMexBlock = true;
    88	      continue;
    89	    }
    90	    if (inMexBlock) {
    91	      // Skip lines that are part of the mex hook block
    92	      if (line.startsWith("#") || line.startsWith("SCORE=") ||
    93	          line.startsWith("case") || line.startsWith("  *") ||
    94	          line.startsWith("esac") || line.startsWith("npx mex") ||
    95	          line.startsWith("node ") || line.trim() === "") {
    96	        continue;
    97	      }
    98	      // Non-mex line found — stop skipping
    99	      inMexBlock = false;
   100	    }
   101	    filtered.push(line);
   102	  }
   103	
   104	  const remaining = filtered.join("\n").trim();
   105	  if (remaining === "#!/bin/sh" || remaining === "") {
   106	    // Only shebang left — remove the file
   107	    unlinkSync(hookPath);
   108	    console.log(chalk.green("Removed mex post-commit hook."));
   109	  } else {
   110	    writeFileSync(hookPath, remaining + "\n");
   111	    chmodSync(hookPath, 0o755);
   112	    console.log(
   113	      chalk.green("Removed mex section from post-commit hook.")
   114	    );
   115	  }
   116	}

    24	/** Retrieve a memory's hash snapshot from the database. Returns null if unavailable. */
    25	function getMemoryHashSnapshot(database: DatabaseExtended | null, memoryId: number): MemoryHashSnapshot | null {
    26	  if (!database || !('prepare' in database)) {
    27	    return null;
    28	  }
    29	
    30	  try {
    31	    const row = database.prepare(`
    32	      SELECT id, content_hash, spec_folder, file_path
    33	      FROM memory_index
    34	      WHERE id = ?
    35	    `).get(memoryId) as MemoryHashSnapshot | undefined;
    36	
    37	    return row ?? null;
    38	  } catch (_err: unknown) {
    39	    return null;
    40	  }
    41	}
    42	
    43	/**
    44	 * Safely append a mutation to the ledger. Returns false on failure so callers
    45	 * can surface warnings in their MCP responses (F1.10 fix).
    46	 */
    47	function appendMutationLedgerSafe(database: DatabaseExtended | null, input: MutationLedgerInput): boolean {
    48	  if (!database) {
    49	    return false;
    50	  }
    51	
    52	  try {
    53	    mutationLedger.initLedger(database as Parameters<typeof mutationLedger.initLedger>[0]);
    54	    mutationLedger.appendEntry(database as Parameters<typeof mutationLedger.appendEntry>[0], {
    55	      mutation_type: input.mutationType,
    56	      reason: input.reason,
    57	      prior_hash: input.priorHash,
    58	      new_hash: input.newHash,
    59	      linked_memory_ids: input.linkedMemoryIds,
    60	      decision_meta: input.decisionMeta,
    61	      actor: input.actor,
    62	      session_id: input.sessionId ?? null,
    63	    });
    64	    return true;
    65	  } catch (err: unknown) {
    66	    const message = toErrorMessage(err);
    67	    console.warn(`[memory-crud] mutation ledger append failed: ${message}`);
    68	    return false;
    69	  }
    70	}
    71	
    72	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    73	   EXPORTS
    74	──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
    75	
    76	export {
    77	  getMemoryHashSnapshot,
    78	  appendMutationLedgerSafe,
    79	};

    26	export const getSchema = <T extends z.ZodRawShape>(shape: T): z.ZodObject<T> => {
    27	  const strict = process.env.SPECKIT_STRICT_SCHEMAS !== 'false';
    28	  const base = z.object(shape);
    29	  return strict ? base.strict() : base.passthrough();

    36	// Guard against safeNumericPreprocess.pipe(z.number()) coercing "", null, and false to 0.
    37	// Use a safe preprocessor that only accepts actual numbers or numeric strings.
    38	const safeNumericPreprocess = z.preprocess((val) => {
    39	  if (typeof val === 'number') return val;
    40	  if (typeof val === 'string' && val.trim().length > 0) {
    41	    const parsed = Number(val);
    42	    return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : val;
    43	  }
    44	  return val;
    45	}, z.number());
    46	
    47	const positiveInt = safeNumericPreprocess.pipe(z.number().int().positive());
    48	const positiveIntMax = (max: number) => safeNumericPreprocess.pipe(z.number().int().min(1).max(max));

    57	    schema = schema.min(minLength);
    58	  }
    59	  return schema.refine(isSafePath, { message: PATH_TRAVERSAL_MESSAGE });
    60	};

   213	      }

   286	    data.warning = mutationLedgerWarning;

   291	    summary,
   292	    data,
   293	    hints,

    40	/** Handle memory_update tool -- updates metadata fields and optionally regenerates embeddings. */

    87	  if (importanceTier !== undefined) updateParams.importanceTier = importanceTier;

    26	    }

   206	    validation.warnings.forEach((warning: string) => console.warn(`[memory]   - ${warning}`));

   229	        validation,

   232	          score: rejectScore,
   233	          attempts: 0,
   234	          fixes: [],
   235	          rejected: true,
   236	          rejectionReason: `V-rule hard block: ${failedRuleIds.join(', ')}`,
   237	        },
   238	        sufficiencyResult: {
   239	          pass: false,
   240	          rejectionCode: MEMORY_SUFFICIENCY_REJECTION_CODE,
   241	          score: 0,
   242	          reasons: [`V-rule hard block: ${failedRuleIds.join(', ')}`],
   243	          evidenceCounts: { primary: 0, support: 0, total: 0, semanticChars: 0, uniqueWords: 0, anchors: 0, triggerPhrases: 0 },
   244	        },
   245	        templateContract: { valid: false, violations: [], missingAnchors: [], unexpectedTemplateArtifacts: [] } as MemoryTemplateContractResult,

   247	        finalizedFileContent: null,

   255	      const parsedWithIndexHints = parsed as ParsedMemoryWithIndexHints;
   256	      parsedWithIndexHints._skipIndex = true;
   257	      parsedWithIndexHints._vRuleIndexBlockIds = vRuleDisposition.indexBlockingRuleIds;
   258	    }

   261	  const qualityLoopResult = runQualityLoop(parsed.content, buildQualityLoopMetadata(parsed, database), {
   262	    emitEvalMetrics: options.emitEvalMetrics,

   265	  parsed.qualityFlags = qualityLoopResult.score.issues;
   266	  if (qualityLoopResult.fixedTriggerPhrases) {

    15	const UNCHANGED_EMBEDDING_STATUSES = new Set(['success', 'pending', 'partial']);
    16	const DEDUP_ELIGIBLE_EMBEDDING_STATUSES = ['success', 'partial'] as const;
    17	const QUALITY_SCORE_EPSILON = 1e-9;
    18	const SCOPE_COLUMNS = [
    19	  ['tenant_id', 'tenantId'],
    20	  ['user_id', 'userId'],
    21	  ['agent_id', 'agentId'],
    22	  ['session_id', 'sessionId'],
    23	  ['shared_space_id', 'sharedSpaceId'],

    31	import type { MemoryScopeMatch } from './types.js';
    32	import { normalizeScopeMatchValue } from './types.js';
    33	
    34	type ScopeColumnName = typeof SCOPE_COLUMNS[number][0];
    35	
    36	interface LatestMemoryLookupRow {
    37	  id: number;
    38	  content_hash: string;
    39	  embedding_status: string | null;
    40	  trigger_phrases: string | null;
    41	  quality_score: number | null;
    42	  quality_flags: string | null;

    52	function buildScopedWhereClauses(scope: MemoryScopeMatch): {
    53	  clauses: string[];
    54	  params: Array<string>;
    55	} {
    56	  const normalizedScope: MemoryScopeMatch = {
    57	    tenantId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.tenantId),
    58	    userId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.userId),
    59	    agentId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.agentId),
    60	    sessionId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sessionId),
    61	    sharedSpaceId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sharedSpaceId),
    62	  };
    63	  const clauses: string[] = [];
    64	  const params: string[] = [];
    65	
    66	  for (const [column, key] of SCOPE_COLUMNS) {
    67	    const value = normalizedScope[key];
    68	    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    69	      clauses.push(`${column} IS NULL`);
    70	      continue;
    71	    }
    72	    clauses.push(`${column} = ?`);
    73	    params.push(value);
    74	  }
    75	
    76	  return { clauses, params };
    77	}

    79	function selectLatestExistingRow(
    80	  database: Database.Database,
    81	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
    82	  pathColumn: ScopeColumnName | 'canonical_file_path' | 'file_path',
    83	  pathValue: string,
    84	  scopeClauses: string[],
    85	  scopeParams: string[],
    86	): LatestMemoryLookupRow | undefined {
    87	  const whereClauses = [
    88	    'spec_folder = ?',
    89	    'parent_id IS NULL',
    90	    `${pathColumn} = ?`,
    91	    ...scopeClauses,
    92	  ];
    93	
    94	  return database.prepare(`
    95	    SELECT id, content_hash, embedding_status, trigger_phrases, quality_score, quality_flags
    96	    FROM memory_index
    97	    WHERE ${whereClauses.join('\n      AND ')}
    98	    ORDER BY id DESC
    99	    LIMIT 1
   100	  `).get(
   101	    parsed.specFolder,
   102	    pathValue,
   103	    ...scopeParams,
   104	  ) as LatestMemoryLookupRow | undefined;
   105	}

   107	function parseJsonStringArray(raw: string | null): string[] {
   108	  if (!raw) {
   109	    return [];
   110	  }
   111	
   112	  try {
   113	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
   114	    return Array.isArray(parsed)
   115	      ? parsed.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
   116	      : [];
   117	  } catch {
   118	    return [];
   119	  }
   120	}
   121	
   122	function normalizeStringArray(values: string[]): string[] {
   123	  return [...new Set(values.map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean))].sort();
   124	}
   125	
   126	function areEquivalentStringArrays(left: string[], right: string[]): boolean {
   127	  const normalizedLeft = normalizeStringArray(left);
   128	  const normalizedRight = normalizeStringArray(right);
   129	
   130	  if (normalizedLeft.length !== normalizedRight.length) {
   131	    return false;
   132	  }
   133	
   134	  return normalizedLeft.every((value, index) => value === normalizedRight[index]);
   135	}
   136	
   137	function isSamePathMetadataEquivalent(
   138	  existing: {
   139	    trigger_phrases: string | null;
   140	    quality_score: number | null;
   141	    quality_flags: string | null;
   142	  },
   143	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
   144	): boolean {
   145	  const persistedTriggerPhrases = parseJsonStringArray(existing.trigger_phrases);
   146	  if (!areEquivalentStringArrays(persistedTriggerPhrases, parsed.triggerPhrases)) {
   147	    return false;
   148	  }
   149	
   150	  const persistedQualityFlags = parseJsonStringArray(existing.quality_flags);
   151	  if (!areEquivalentStringArrays(persistedQualityFlags, parsed.qualityFlags ?? [])) {
   152	    return false;
   153	  }
   154	
   155	  const persistedQualityScore = existing.quality_score ?? 0;
   156	  const parsedQualityScore = parsed.qualityScore ?? 0;
   157	  return Math.abs(persistedQualityScore - parsedQualityScore) <= QUALITY_SCORE_EPSILON;
   158	}
   159	
   160	function verifyStoredContentMatch(
   161	  storedContent: string | null | undefined,
   162	  storedPath: string | null | undefined,
   163	  incomingContent: string,
   164	): boolean | null {
   165	  if (typeof storedContent === 'string') {
   166	    return storedContent === incomingContent;
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  if (typeof storedPath === 'string' && storedPath.length > 0) {
   170	    try {
   171	      if (fs.existsSync(storedPath)) {
   172	        return fs.readFileSync(storedPath, 'utf-8') === incomingContent;
   173	      }
   174	    } catch {
   175	      return null;
   176	    }
   177	  }
   178	
   179	  return null;
   180	}

   182	export function checkExistingRow(
   183	  database: Database.Database,
   184	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
   185	  canonicalFilePath: string,
   186	  filePath: string,
   187	  force: boolean,
   188	  warnings: string[] | undefined,
   189	  scope: MemoryScopeMatch = {},
   190	): IndexResult | null {
   191	  const { clauses: scopeClauses, params: scopeParams } = buildScopedWhereClauses(scope);
   192	  const candidates = [
   193	    selectLatestExistingRow(
   194	      database,
   195	      parsed,
   196	      'canonical_file_path',
   197	      canonicalFilePath,
   198	      scopeClauses,
   199	      scopeParams,
   200	    ),
   201	  ];
   202	
   203	  if (filePath !== canonicalFilePath) {
   204	    candidates.push(
   205	      selectLatestExistingRow(
   206	        database,
   207	        parsed,
   208	        'file_path',
   209	        filePath,
   210	        scopeClauses,
   211	        scopeParams,
   212	      ),
   213	    );
   214	  }
   215	
   216	  const existing = candidates
   217	    .filter((candidate): candidate is LatestMemoryLookupRow => candidate !== undefined)
   218	    .sort((left, right) => right.id - left.id)[0];
   219	
   220	  const existingStatus = existing?.embedding_status ?? null;
   221	  const isUnchangedEligible = existingStatus !== null && UNCHANGED_EMBEDDING_STATUSES.has(existingStatus);
   222	  const isMetadataEquivalent = existing
   223	    ? isSamePathMetadataEquivalent(existing, parsed)
   224	    : false;
   225	
   226	  // P1-4 FIX: Check content hash even during force reindex to prevent duplicate
   227	  // row accumulation. If content AND metadata are identical, the embedding would
   228	  // not change either, so re-indexing provides no value and creates duplicates.
   229	  if (existing && existing.content_hash === parsed.contentHash && isUnchangedEligible && isMetadataEquivalent) {
   230	    return {
   231	      status: 'unchanged',
   232	      id: existing.id,
   233	      specFolder: parsed.specFolder,
   234	      title: parsed.title ?? '',
   235	      triggerPhrases: parsed.triggerPhrases,
   236	      contextType: parsed.contextType,
   237	      importanceTier: parsed.importanceTier,
   238	      warnings,
   239	    };
   240	  }
   241	
   242	  return null;
   243	}

   245	export function checkContentHashDedup(
   246	  database: Database.Database,
   247	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
   248	  force: boolean,
   249	  warnings: string[] | undefined,
   250	  samePathExclusion?: SamePathDedupExclusion,
   251	  scope: MemoryScopeMatch = {},
   252	): IndexResult | null {
   253	  if (!force) {
   254	    const { clauses: scopeClauses, params: scopeParams } = buildScopedWhereClauses(scope);
   255	    const whereClauses = [
   256	      'spec_folder = ?',
   257	      'content_hash = ?',
   258	      'parent_id IS NULL',
   259	      'embedding_status IN (?, ?)',
   260	      ...scopeClauses,
   261	    ];
   262	    const duplicateParams: Array<string> = [
   263	      parsed.specFolder,
   264	      parsed.contentHash,
   265	      ...DEDUP_ELIGIBLE_EMBEDDING_STATUSES,
   266	      ...scopeParams,
   267	    ];
   268	
   269	    if (samePathExclusion) {
   270	      whereClauses.push('file_path != ?');
   271	      duplicateParams.push(samePathExclusion.filePath);
   272	      whereClauses.push('(canonical_file_path IS NULL OR canonical_file_path != ?)');
   273	      duplicateParams.push(samePathExclusion.canonicalFilePath);
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    const duplicateByHash = database.prepare(`
   277	      SELECT id, file_path, title, content_text
   278	      FROM memory_index
   279	      WHERE ${whereClauses.join('\n        AND ')}
   280	      ORDER BY id DESC
   281	      LIMIT 1
   282	    `).get(...duplicateParams) as DuplicateLookupRow | undefined;
   283	
   284	    if (duplicateByHash) {
   285	      const verifiedMatch = verifyStoredContentMatch(
   286	        duplicateByHash.content_text,
   287	        duplicateByHash.file_path,
   288	        parsed.content,
   289	      );
   290	      if (verifiedMatch === false) {
   291	        console.warn(`[memory-save] Hash match for memory #${duplicateByHash.id} failed secondary content verification; continuing save`);
   292	        return null;
   293	      }
   294	      console.error(`[memory-save] T054: Duplicate content detected (hash match id=${duplicateByHash.id}), skipping embedding`);
   295	      return {
   296	        status: 'duplicate',
   297	        id: duplicateByHash.id,
   298	        specFolder: parsed.specFolder,
   299	        title: parsed.title ?? duplicateByHash.title ?? '',
   300	        triggerPhrases: parsed.triggerPhrases,
   301	        contextType: parsed.contextType,
   302	        importanceTier: parsed.importanceTier,
   303	        warnings,
   304	        message: `Duplicate content detected: identical to existing memory #${duplicateByHash.id} (${duplicateByHash.file_path}). Skipping embedding generation.`,
   305	      };
   306	    }
   307	  }
   308	
   309	  return null;
   310	}

    95	export function findSamePathExistingMemory(
    96	  database: BetterSqlite3.Database,
    97	  specFolder: string,
    98	  canonicalFilePath: string,
    99	  filePath: string,
   100	  scope: MemoryScopeMatch = {},
   101	): { id: number; title: string | null; content_hash?: string | null } | undefined {
   102	  const tenantId = normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.tenantId);
   103	  const userId = normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.userId);
   104	  const agentId = normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.agentId);
   105	  const sessionId = normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sessionId);
   106	  const sharedSpaceId = normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sharedSpaceId);

   109	    SELECT id, title, content_hash
   110	    FROM memory_index
   111	    WHERE spec_folder = ?
   112	      AND parent_id IS NULL
   113	      AND (canonical_file_path = ? OR file_path = ?)
   114	      AND ((? IS NULL AND tenant_id IS NULL) OR tenant_id = ?)
   115	      AND ((? IS NULL AND user_id IS NULL) OR user_id = ?)
   116	      AND ((? IS NULL AND agent_id IS NULL) OR agent_id = ?)
   117	      AND ((? IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL) OR session_id = ?)
   118	      AND ((? IS NULL AND shared_space_id IS NULL) OR shared_space_id = ?)
   119	    ORDER BY id DESC
   120	    LIMIT 1

   123	    canonicalFilePath,
   124	    filePath,
   125	    tenantId,
   126	    tenantId,
   127	    userId,
   128	    userId,
   129	    agentId,
   130	    agentId,
   131	    sessionId,
   132	    sessionId,
   133	    sharedSpaceId,
   134	    sharedSpaceId,
   135	  ) as { id: number; title: string | null; content_hash?: string | null } | undefined;
   136	}

   138	/**

   142	export function createMemoryRecord(

   171	      parsed.specFolder,
   172	      canonicalFilePath,
   173	      filePath,
   174	      scope,

   176	    const lineageRouting = resolveCreateRecordLineage(peDecision, samePathExisting?.id ?? null);
   177	    const predecessorMemoryId = lineageRouting.predecessorMemoryId;
   178	    const transitionEvent = lineageRouting.transitionEvent;

   180	    const memory_id: number = embedding
   181	      ? vectorIndex.indexMemory({
   182	          specFolder: parsed.specFolder,
   183	          filePath,
   184	          title: parsed.title,
   185	          triggerPhrases: parsed.triggerPhrases,
   186	          importanceWeight,
   187	          embedding,
   188	          encodingIntent,
   189	          documentType: parsed.documentType || 'memory',
   190	          specLevel,
   191	          contentText: parsed.content,
   192	          qualityScore: parsed.qualityScore,
   193	          qualityFlags: parsed.qualityFlags,
   194	          appendOnly: predecessorMemoryId != null,
   195	        })
   196	      : vectorIndex.indexMemoryDeferred({
   197	          specFolder: parsed.specFolder,
   198	          filePath,
   199	          title: parsed.title,
   200	          triggerPhrases: parsed.triggerPhrases,
   201	          importanceWeight,
   202	          failureReason: persistedEmbeddingFailureReason,
   203	          encodingIntent,
   204	          documentType: parsed.documentType || 'memory',
   205	          specLevel,
   206	          contentText: parsed.content,
   207	          qualityScore: parsed.qualityScore,
   208	          qualityFlags: parsed.qualityFlags,
   209	          appendOnly: predecessorMemoryId != null,
   210	        });

   212	    const fileMetadata = incrementalIndex.getFileMetadata(filePath);
   213	    const fileMtimeMs = fileMetadata ? fileMetadata.mtime : null;
   214	
   215	    applyPostInsertMetadata(database, memory_id, {
   216	      content_hash: parsed.contentHash,
   217	      context_type: parsed.contextType,
   218	      importance_tier: parsed.importanceTier,
   219	      memory_type: parsed.memoryType,
   220	      type_inference_source: parsed.memoryTypeSource,
   221	      stability: fsrsScheduler.DEFAULT_INITIAL_STABILITY,
   222	      difficulty: fsrsScheduler.DEFAULT_INITIAL_DIFFICULTY,
   223	      file_mtime_ms: fileMtimeMs,
   224	      encoding_intent: encodingIntent,
   225	      document_type: parsed.documentType || 'memory',
   226	      spec_level: specLevel,
   227	      quality_score: parsed.qualityScore ?? 0,
   228	      quality_flags: JSON.stringify(parsed.qualityFlags ?? []),
   229	    });

   231	    if (embedding && peDecision.action === predictionErrorGate.ACTION.CREATE_LINKED && peDecision.existingMemoryId != null) {

   233	        database.prepare(`
   234	          UPDATE memory_index
   235	          SET related_memories = ?
   236	          WHERE id = ?
   237	        `).run(JSON.stringify([peDecision.existingMemoryId]), memory_id);
   238	      } catch (err: unknown) {
   239	        const message = toErrorMessage(err);

   241	      }
   242	    }

   244	    if (predecessorMemoryId != null) {

   249	        WHERE id = ?

   270	          content_text: parsed.content,

   293	      }

   296	    }

   298	    return memory_id;
   299	  });

    43	/**
    44	 * Similarity threshold above which two memories are considered near-duplicates
    45	 * and auto-merged.  Requires SPECKIT_ASSISTIVE_RECONSOLIDATION=true.
    46	 */
    47	export const ASSISTIVE_AUTO_MERGE_THRESHOLD = 0.96;
    48	
    49	/**
    50	 * Similarity threshold above which two memories are considered borderline
    51	 * (possible supersede/complement).  A recommendation is logged but no
    52	 * destructive action is taken.
    53	 */
    54	export const ASSISTIVE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD = 0.88;
    55	
    56	/**
    57	 * Check whether the assistive reconsolidation feature is enabled.
    58	 * Default: ON (graduated). Set SPECKIT_ASSISTIVE_RECONSOLIDATION=false to disable.
    59	 */
    60	export function isAssistiveReconsolidationEnabled(): boolean {
    61	  return _isAssistiveReconsolidationEnabled();
    62	}
    63	
    64	/**
    65	 * Determine the assistive reconsolidation classification for a pair of memories
    66	 * based on their similarity score.
    67	 *
    68	 * Tiers:
    69	 *   similarity >= 0.96  → auto-merge (near-duplicate)
    70	 *   0.88 <= sim < 0.96  → review (supersede or complement recommendation)
    71	 *   sim < 0.88          → keep separate (complement)
    72	 *
    73	 * @param similarity - Cosine similarity in [0, 1]
    74	 * @returns Classification string
    75	 */
    76	export function classifyAssistiveSimilarity(
    77	  similarity: number
    78	): 'auto_merge' | 'review' | 'keep_separate' {
    79	  if (similarity >= ASSISTIVE_AUTO_MERGE_THRESHOLD) return 'auto_merge';
    80	  if (similarity >= ASSISTIVE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD)     return 'review';
    81	  return 'keep_separate';
    82	}
    83	
    84	/**
    85	 * Classify whether a borderline (review-tier) memory pair should be
    86	 * superseded or complemented.
    87	 *
    88	 * Heuristic: if the newer memory's content is longer than the older one,
    89	 * it likely adds information (complement); otherwise it likely replaces it
    90	 * (supersede).  Callers may override with domain-specific logic.
    91	 *
    92	 * @param olderContent - Content text of the older memory
    93	 * @param newerContent - Content text of the newer memory
    94	 * @returns 'supersede' or 'complement'
    95	 */
    96	export function classifySupersededOrComplement(
    97	  olderContent: string,
    98	  newerContent: string
    99	): 'supersede' | 'complement' {
   100	  const olderLen = (olderContent ?? '').length;
   101	  const newerLen = (newerContent ?? '').length;
   102	  // Newer is substantially longer → it complements rather than replaces
   103	  return newerLen > olderLen * 1.2 ? 'complement' : 'supersede';
   104	}

   107	 * Log a borderline recommendation to the console (shadow-only).
   108	 * No database writes are performed — this is purely observational.
   109	 *
   110	 * @param recommendation - The recommendation payload
   111	 */
   112	export function logAssistiveRecommendation(
   113	  recommendation: AssistiveRecommendation
   114	): void {
   115	  console.warn(
   116	    `[reconsolidation-bridge] assistive recommendation: ` +
   117	    `${recommendation.classification} — ` +
   118	    `older=${recommendation.olderMemoryId} newer=${recommendation.newerMemoryId ?? 'pending'} ` +
   119	    `similarity=${recommendation.similarity.toFixed(3)}`
   120	  );
   121	}

   134	function repairBm25Document(args: {
   135	  memoryId: number;
   136	  title: string | null;
   137	  contentText: string;
   138	  triggerPhrases: string[];
   139	  filePath: string;
   140	  contextLabel: string;
   141	}): string | null {
   142	  try {
   143	    const bm25 = bm25Index.getIndex();
   144	    const documentText = bm25Index.buildBm25DocumentText({
   145	      title: args.title,
   146	      content_text: args.contentText,
   147	      trigger_phrases: args.triggerPhrases,
   148	      file_path: args.filePath,
   149	    });
   150	
   151	    bm25.removeDocument(String(args.memoryId));
   152	    bm25.addDocument(String(args.memoryId), documentText);
   153	    return null;
   154	  } catch (repairErr: unknown) {
   155	    const repairMessage = toErrorMessage(repairErr);
   156	    console.warn(`[memory-save] Immediate BM25 repair failed (${args.contextLabel}): ${repairMessage}`);
   157	    return `BM25 repair failed after ${args.contextLabel} for memory ${args.memoryId}: ${repairMessage}`;
   158	  }
   159	}

   160	export function findSimilarMemories(
   161	  embedding: Float32Array | number[],
   162	  specFolder: string,
   163	  findSimilar: FindSimilarFn,
   164	  limit: number = SIMILAR_MEMORY_LIMIT
   165	): SimilarMemory[] {
   166	  try {
   167	    return findSimilar(embedding, { limit, specFolder });

   179	/**

   185	export function determineAction(similarity: number): ReconsolidationAction {
   186	  if (similarity >= MERGE_THRESHOLD) {

   188	  }
   189	  if (similarity >= CONFLICT_THRESHOLD) {
   190	    return 'conflict';
   191	  }
   192	  return 'complement';

     1	// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     2	// MODULE: Mutation Ledger
     3	// ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
     4	// Feature catalog: Transaction wrappers on mutation handlers
     5	// Append-only audit trail for all memory mutations
     6	// SQLite triggers enforce immutability (no UPDATE/DELETE on ledger)
     7	import { createHash } from 'crypto';
     8	import type Database from 'better-sqlite3';
     9	import { runInTransaction } from './transaction-manager.js';
    10	
    11	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    12	   1. TYPES
    13	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
    14	
    15	type MutationType = 'create' | 'update' | 'delete' | 'merge' | 'archive' | 'restore' | 'reindex';
    16	
    17	interface MutationLedgerEntry {
    18	  id: number;
    19	  timestamp: string;
    20	  mutation_type: MutationType;
    21	  reason: string;
    22	  prior_hash: string | null;
    23	  new_hash: string;
    24	  linked_memory_ids: string; // JSON array
    25	  decision_meta: string;     // JSON object
    26	  actor: string;
    27	  session_id: string | null;
    28	}
    29	
    30	interface AppendEntryInput {
    31	  mutation_type: MutationType;
    32	  reason: string;
    33	  prior_hash: string | null;
    34	  new_hash: string;
    35	  linked_memory_ids: number[];
    36	  decision_meta: Record<string, unknown>;
    37	  actor: string;
    38	  session_id?: string | null;
    39	}
    40	
    41	interface GetEntriesOptions {
    42	  mutation_type?: MutationType;
    43	  actor?: string;
    44	  session_id?: string;
    45	  since?: string;    // ISO timestamp
    46	  until?: string;    // ISO timestamp
    47	  limit?: number;
    48	  offset?: number;
    49	}

    53	  attemptsSoFar: number;
    54	  nextAttempt: number;
    55	  maxRetries: number;
    56	  shouldRetry: boolean;
    57	  exhausted: boolean;
    58	}
    59	
    60	interface DivergenceEscalationPayload {
    61	  code: 'E_DIVERGENCE_RECONCILE_RETRY_EXHAUSTED';
    62	  normalizedPath: string;
    63	  attempts: number;
    64	  maxRetries: number;
    65	  recommendation: 'manual_triage_required';

    69

    84	
    85	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    86	   2. SCHEMA SQL
    87	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
    88	
    89	const LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL = `
    90	  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutation_ledger (
    91	    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    92	    timestamp TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
    93	    mutation_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(mutation_type IN ('create','update','delete','merge','archive','restore','reindex')),
    94	    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    95	    prior_hash TEXT,
    96	    new_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    97	    linked_memory_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    98	    decision_meta TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    99	    actor TEXT NOT NULL,
   100	    session_id TEXT
   101	  )
   102	`;
   103	
   104	const LEDGER_INDEX_SQL = `
   105	  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_type ON mutation_ledger(mutation_type);
   106	  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_actor ON mutation_ledger(actor);
   107	  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_timestamp ON mutation_ledger(timestamp);
   108	  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_session ON mutation_ledger(session_id);
   109	  CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ledger_memory_type_created_at ON mutation_ledger(
   110	    CAST(json_extract(linked_memory_ids, '$[0]') AS INTEGER),
   111	    mutation_type,
   112	    timestamp
   113	  )
   114	`;
   115	
   116	const LEDGER_TRIGGER_SQL = `
   117	  CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS prevent_ledger_update BEFORE UPDATE ON mutation_ledger
   118	  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'mutation_ledger is append-only'); END;
   119	  CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS prevent_ledger_delete BEFORE DELETE ON mutation_ledger
   120	  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'mutation_ledger is append-only'); END
   121	`;
   122	
   123	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   124	   3. INITIALIZATION
   125	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
   126	
   127	function initLedger(db: Database.Database): void {
   128	  db.exec(LEDGER_SCHEMA_SQL);
   129	  db.exec(LEDGER_INDEX_SQL);
   130	  db.exec(LEDGER_TRIGGER_SQL);
   131	}
   132	
   133	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   134	   4. HASH COMPUTATION
   135	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
   136	
   137	function computeHash(content: string): string {
   138	  return createHash('sha256').update(content, 'utf8').digest('hex');
   139	}
   140	
   141	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   142	   5. APPEND ENTRY
   143	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
   144	
   145	function appendEntry(db: Database.Database, entry: AppendEntryInput): MutationLedgerEntry {
   146	  const linkedJson = JSON.stringify(entry.linked_memory_ids);
   147	  const metaJson = JSON.stringify(entry.decision_meta);
   148	
   149	  const stmt = db.prepare(`
   150	    INSERT INTO mutation_ledger (mutation_type, reason, prior_hash, new_hash, linked_memory_ids, decision_meta, actor, session_id)
   151	    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
   152	  `);
   153	
   154	  const result = stmt.run(
   155	    entry.mutation_type,
   156	    entry.reason,
   157	    entry.prior_hash,
   158	    entry.new_hash,
   159	    linkedJson,
   160	    metaJson,
   161	    entry.actor,
   162	    entry.session_id ?? null
   163	  );
   164	
   165	  const id = (result as { lastInsertRowid: number | bigint }).lastInsertRowid as number;
   166	
   167	  const row = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM mutation_ledger WHERE id = ?').get(id) as MutationLedgerEntry;
   168	  return row;
   169	}

   171	/* ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   172	   6. QUERY ENTRIES
   173	----------------------------------------------------------------*/
   174	
   175	function getEntries(db: Database.Database, opts: GetEntriesOptions = {}): MutationLedgerEntry[] {
   176	  const conditions: string[] = [];
   177	  const params: Array<string | number> = [];
   178	
   179	  if (opts.mutation_type) {
   180	    conditions.push('mutation_type = ?');
   181	    params.push(opts.mutation_type);
   182	  }
   183	  if (opts.actor) {
   184	    conditions.push('actor = ?');
   185	    params.push(opts.actor);
   186	  }
   187	  if (opts.session_id) {
   188	    conditions.push('session_id = ?');
   189	    params.push(opts.session_id);
   190	  }
   191	  if (opts.since) {
   192	    conditions.push('timestamp >= ?');
   193	    params.push(opts.since);
   194	  }
   195	  if (opts.until) {
   196	    conditions.push('timestamp <= ?');
   197	    params.push(opts.until);
   198	  }
   199	
   200	  const where = conditions.length > 0 ? `WHERE ${conditions.join(' AND ')}` : '';
   201	  // String interpolation in LIMIT/OFFSET is safe here because both values
   202	  // Are coerced to non-negative integers via Math.floor + Math.max before use —

     4	import fs from 'fs';
     5	import path from 'path';
     6	
     7	/** Returns true for errors indicating a missing path segment (ENOENT/ENOTDIR). */
     8	function isMissingPathError(err: unknown): boolean {
     9	  const code = (err as NodeJS.ErrnoException | undefined)?.code;
    10	  return code === 'ENOENT' || code === 'ENOTDIR';
    11	}
    12	
    13	function normalizePathKey(filePath: string): string {
    14	  const normalized = filePath.replace(/\\/g, '/');
    15	  return process.platform === 'win32' ? normalized.toLowerCase() : normalized;
    16	}
    17	
    18	/**
    19	 * Canonical identity for path deduplication.
    20	 *
    21	 * - Uses realpath when possible so symlink aliases collapse to one key.
    22	 * - Falls back to resolved absolute path when file does not exist.
    23	 */
    24	export function getCanonicalPathKey(filePath: string): string {
    25	  try {
    26	    return normalizePathKey(fs.realpathSync(filePath));
    27	  } catch {
    28	    return normalizePathKey(path.resolve(filePath));
    29	  }
    30	}
    31	
    32	/**
    33	 * Resolve symlinks before spec-folder extraction so that paths through
    34	 * symlinked directories (e.g. `.claude/specs → ../.opencode/specs`)
    35	 * produce the same spec_folder string as the real path.
    36	 *
    37	 * Handles the atomic-save case where the file doesn't exist yet by
    38	 * walking up to the nearest existing ancestor and resolving from there.
    39	 */
    40	export function canonicalizeForSpecFolderExtraction(filePath: string): string {
    41	  try {
    42	    return fs.realpathSync(filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    43	  } catch (err: unknown) {
    44	    if (!isMissingPathError(err)) {
    45	      // EACCES, ELOOP, EPERM — do not parent-walk, return resolved path
    46	      return path.resolve(filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    47	    }
    48	    // ENOENT/ENOTDIR — file doesn't exist yet (atomic save flow)
    49	    const segments: string[] = [];
    50	    let probe = path.resolve(filePath);
    51	    while (!fs.existsSync(probe)) {
    52	      const parent = path.dirname(probe);
    53	      if (parent === probe) return path.resolve(filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    54	      segments.unshift(path.basename(probe));
    55	      probe = parent;
    56	    }
    57	    try {
    58	      const canonicalBase = fs.realpathSync(probe);
    59	      return path.join(canonicalBase, ...segments).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    60	    } catch {
    61	      return path.resolve(filePath).replace(/\\/g, '/');
    62	    }
    63	  }
    64	}

    12	/** Get days since a file was last modified in git */
    13	export async function daysSinceLastChange(
    14	  filePath: string,
    15	  cwd?: string
    16	): Promise<number | null> {
    17	  try {
    18	    const git = getGit(cwd);
    19	    const log = await git.log({ file: filePath, maxCount: 1 });
    20	    if (!log.latest?.date) return null;
    21	    const lastDate = new Date(log.latest.date);
    22	    const now = new Date();
    23	    return Math.floor(
    24	      (now.getTime() - lastDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
    25	    );
    26	  } catch {
    27	    return null;
    28	  }
    29	}

    31	/** Get number of commits since a file was last modified */
    32	export async function commitsSinceLastChange(
    33	  filePath: string,
    34	  cwd?: string
    35	): Promise<number | null> {
    36	  try {
    37	    const git = getGit(cwd);
    38	    const fileLog = await git.log({ file: filePath, maxCount: 1 });
    39	    if (!fileLog.latest?.hash) return null;
    40	
    41	    const allLog = await git.log();
    42	    const totalCommits = allLog.all.length;
    43	    const fileIndex = allLog.all.findIndex(
    44	      (c) => c.hash === fileLog.latest!.hash
    45	    );
    46	    return fileIndex === -1 ? null : fileIndex;
    47	  } catch {
    48	    return null;
    49	  }
    50	}

    52	function buildScopedWhereClauses(scope: MemoryScopeMatch): {
    53	  clauses: string[];
    54	  params: Array<string>;
    55	} {
    56	  const normalizedScope: MemoryScopeMatch = {
    57	    tenantId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.tenantId),
    58	    userId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.userId),
    59	    agentId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.agentId),
    60	    sessionId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sessionId),
    61	    sharedSpaceId: normalizeScopeMatchValue(scope.sharedSpaceId),
    62	  };
    63	  const clauses: string[] = [];
    64	  const params: string[] = [];
    65	
    66	  for (const [column, key] of SCOPE_COLUMNS) {
    67	    const value = normalizedScope[key];
    68	    if (value === null || value === undefined) {
    69	      clauses.push(`${column} IS NULL`);
    70	      continue;
    71	    }
    72	    clauses.push(`${column} = ?`);
    73	    params.push(value);
    74	  }
    75	
    76	  return { clauses, params };
    77	}

    80	  database: Database.Database,

    89	    'parent_id IS NULL',
    90	    `${pathColumn} = ?`,
    91	    ...scopeClauses,
    92	  ];

    96	    FROM memory_index

    98	    ORDER BY id DESC
    99	    LIMIT 1
   100	  `).get(
   101	    parsed.specFolder,
   102	    pathValue,
   103	    ...scopeParams,
   104	  ) as LatestMemoryLookupRow | undefined;
   105	}

   107	function parseJsonStringArray(raw: string | null): string[] {
   108	  if (!raw) {
   109	    return [];
   110	  }
   111	
   112	  try {
   113	    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as unknown;
   114	    return Array.isArray(parsed)
   115	      ? parsed.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string')
   116	      : [];
   117	  } catch {
   118	    return [];
   119	  }
   120	}
   121	
   122	function normalizeStringArray(values: string[]): string[] {
   123	  return [...new Set(values.map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean))].sort();
   124	}
   125	
   126	function areEquivalentStringArrays(left: string[], right: string[]): boolean {
   127	  const normalizedLeft = normalizeStringArray(left);
   128	  const normalizedRight = normalizeStringArray(right);
   129	
   130	  if (normalizedLeft.length !== normalizedRight.length) {
   131	    return false;
   132	  }
   133	
   134	  return normalizedLeft.every((value, index) => value === normalizedRight[index]);
   135	}

   137	function isSamePathMetadataEquivalent(
   138	  existing: {
   139	    trigger_phrases: string | null;
   140	    quality_score: number | null;
   141	    quality_flags: string | null;
   142	  },
   143	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
   144	): boolean {
   145	  const persistedTriggerPhrases = parseJsonStringArray(existing.trigger_phrases);
   146	  if (!areEquivalentStringArrays(persistedTriggerPhrases, parsed.triggerPhrases)) {
   147	    return false;
   148	  }
   149	
   150	  const persistedQualityFlags = parseJsonStringArray(existing.quality_flags);
   151	  if (!areEquivalentStringArrays(persistedQualityFlags, parsed.qualityFlags ?? [])) {
   152	    return false;
   153	  }
   154	
   155	  const persistedQualityScore = existing.quality_score ?? 0;
   156	  const parsedQualityScore = parsed.qualityScore ?? 0;
   157	  return Math.abs(persistedQualityScore - parsedQualityScore) <= QUALITY_SCORE_EPSILON;
   158	}

   160	function verifyStoredContentMatch(
   161	  storedContent: string | null | undefined,
   162	  storedPath: string | null | undefined,
   163	  incomingContent: string,
   164	): boolean | null {
   165	  if (typeof storedContent === 'string') {
   166	    return storedContent === incomingContent;
   167	  }
   168	
   169	  if (typeof storedPath === 'string' && storedPath.length > 0) {
   170	    try {
   171	      if (fs.existsSync(storedPath)) {
   172	        return fs.readFileSync(storedPath, 'utf-8') === incomingContent;
   173	      }
   174	    } catch {
   175	      return null;
   176	    }
   177	  }
   178	
   179	  return null;
   180	}

   245	export function checkContentHashDedup(
   246	  database: Database.Database,
   247	  parsed: ParsedMemory,
   248	  force: boolean,
   249	  warnings: string[] | undefined,
   250	  samePathExclusion?: SamePathDedupExclusion,
   251	  scope: MemoryScopeMatch = {},
   252	): IndexResult | null {
   253	  if (!force) {
   254	    const { clauses: scopeClauses, params: scopeParams } = buildScopedWhereClauses(scope);
   255	    const whereClauses = [
   256	      'spec_folder = ?',
   257	      'content_hash = ?',
   258	      'parent_id IS NULL',
   259	      'embedding_status IN (?, ?)',
   260	      ...scopeClauses,
   261	    ];
   262	    const duplicateParams: Array<string> = [
   263	      parsed.specFolder,
   264	      parsed.contentHash,
   265	      ...DEDUP_ELIGIBLE_EMBEDDING_STATUSES,
   266	      ...scopeParams,

   271	      duplicateParams.push(samePathExclusion.filePath);
   272	      whereClauses.push('(canonical_file_path IS NULL OR canonical_file_path != ?)');
   273	      duplicateParams.push(samePathExclusion.canonicalFilePath);
   274	    }
   275	
   276	    const duplicateByHash = database.prepare(`

   278	      FROM memory_index
   279	      WHERE ${whereClauses.join('\n        AND ')}
   280	      ORDER BY id DESC
   281	      LIMIT 1
   282	    `).get(...duplicateParams) as DuplicateLookupRow | undefined;

   284	    if (duplicateByHash) {

   288	        parsed.content,

   290	      if (verifiedMatch === false) {

   292	        return null;
   293	      }
   294	      console.error(`[memory-save] T054: Duplicate content detected (hash match id=${duplicateByHash.id}), skipping embedding`);
   295	      return {
   296	        status: 'duplicate',
   297	        id: duplicateByHash.id,
   298	        specFolder: parsed.specFolder,
   299	        title: parsed.title ?? duplicateByHash.title ?? '',
   300	        triggerPhrases: parsed.triggerPhrases,
   301	        contextType: parsed.contextType,
   302	        importanceTier: parsed.importanceTier,

    35	interface LineageRoutingDecision {

    41	export function resolveCreateRecordLineage(
    42	  peDecision: PeDecision,
    43	  samePathExistingId: number | null,
    44	): LineageRoutingDecision {
    45	  if (peDecision.action === predictionErrorGate.ACTION.SUPERSEDE && peDecision.existingMemoryId != null) {
    46	    return {
    47	      predecessorMemoryId: samePathExistingId,
    48	      transitionEvent: samePathExistingId != null ? 'SUPERSEDE' : 'CREATE',
    49	      causalSupersedesMemoryId: samePathExistingId === peDecision.existingMemoryId
    50	        ? null
    51	        : peDecision.existingMemoryId,
    52	    };
    53	  }
    54	
    55	  if (samePathExistingId != null) {
    56	    return {
    57	      predecessorMemoryId: samePathExistingId,
    58	      transitionEvent: 'UPDATE',
    59	      causalSupersedesMemoryId: null,
    60	    };
    61	  }
    62	
    63	  return {
    64	    predecessorMemoryId: null,
    65	    transitionEvent: 'CREATE',
    66	    causalSupersedesMemoryId: null,
    67	  };
    68	}

    70	function recordCrossPathSupersedesEdge(

    72	  memoryId: number,

    75	): void {

    79

    81	  const evidence = reason && reason.trim().length > 0
    82	    ? reason.trim()
    83	    : 'Prediction-error contradiction across different file paths';
    84	  causalEdges.insertEdge(
    85	    String(memoryId),
    86	    String(supersededMemoryId),
    87	    causalEdges.RELATION_TYPES.SUPERSEDES,
    88	    1.0,
    89	    evidence,
    90	    true,
    91	    'auto',
    92	  );

   205	          specLevel,

   207	          qualityScore: parsed.qualityScore,

   218	      importance_tier: parsed.importanceTier,
   219	      memory_type: parsed.memoryType,
   220	      type_inference_source: parsed.memoryTypeSource,
